notes.title: CONTACT THE DEVELOPER
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38225809/3d463c2e593f7e1ed391127d66aa39eb6b2bc53c.png[/img]

As we are trying to get on top of our talking-to-you-guys game, it’s just about time for us to finally start mentioning our contact info. 

If there is anything you wish to discuss with us, share an opinion or ask a question please feel free to email us at konnichiwa.games.contact@gmail.com. 

Your opinion is always welcome!

Cheers, 
Konnichiwa Games

notes.title: The Last of Waifus in now RELEASED!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38225809/959a0236de6a632e647ebf81f950b34f10d49489.png[/img]

[b]It's been a long time[/b] since The Last of Waifus was firstly shaped into a game. We worked hard on turning all our dreams into the actual game for you, however The Last of Waifus is not yet how we imagined it to be. 

We want to do our game better and focus on this project for at least a month or so more. So do not worry, [b]it is not the final version[/b] of The Last of Waifus!

We hope to hear both [b]your feedback and suggestions[/b]. We are waiting for your ideas!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359650/The_Last_of_Waifus/

Also, the game features a FREE Nudity DLC:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1365990/The_Last_of_Waifus__Nudity_DLC_18/

We wish you the best gaming! 

Cheers, 
Konnichiwa Games
